cues: Permission: may I come in is formal; can I is informal; could I is polite.
But learn this pair above all.
Mustn't means it is forbidden: you mustn't park here.
Needn't means there is no need; you are free: you needn't come on Saturday.
Every year candidates write needn't where the sentence means forbidden.
